entities.summary: Arab, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Birth of Islam (632–661). Preceded by Ridda Wars — Abu Bakr reunifies Arabia under Islam and Conquest of Mecca — Muhammad enters Mecca and cleanses the Kaaba. Their legacy influenced Assassination of Caliph Uthman in Medina triggers the First Fitna and Siege of Mecca — Umayyad forces damage the Kaaba during the Second Fitna.
